notes: Read-only review of spec.md and build.R: dating uses filing_year, the first-listed filter and missing-class filter match, the base window is filing years t-5..t-1 and the forward window is t+1..t+3 (year t excluded from both), new_classes is an anti-join of forward against base, and the NA/0 rules and one-row-per-firm-year output match. The 1987-2015 focal range is not enforced in code, but spec rule 11 makes firm_year the source of output years, so this is not treated as a deviation.
